title: FounderProfile
description: FROZEN CONTRACT. Owner: B (Intelligence Lead). Changing any field name or type requires all three leads to agree in writing (see CONTRACT.md §8). Every field below traces to a documented grant requirement in CONTEXT.md §5 — if a field has no grant that needs it, it does not belong here.

profile_version.description: Bump ONLY by written agreement of all three leads. A(UI) may assert on this.

profile_id.description: uuid v4, generated once on first intake screen by A.

answers.description: Founder-facing data. UNANSWERED = key absent or null. NEVER "" or 0 or false. A false boolean means the founder said no; null means we have not asked yet. The eligibility engine treats these differently.

citizenship.description: VFG + Startup SG Founder: SG|PR blocking. Uppercase, matches CONTEXT.md rules example.

is_key_applicant.description: VFG requires the KEY applicant be SG/PR, not merely a team member.

first_time_founder.description: Startup SG Founder: must be true, blocking.

previously_incorporated.description: Startup SG Founder: must be false, blocking.

equity_pct.description: Startup SG Founder: >=30 (held or proposed), blocking.

access_needs.description: Self-declared, optional, NEVER an eligibility input. Drives UI affordances only. No rule file may reference this field.

one_liner.description: AI-extracted from free text at step venture_idea.

incorporated.description: VFG: if false, SSO partnership and/or beneficiary validation expected.

uen.description: Populated by ACRA lookup, or founder-entered then ACRA-confirmed.

entity_status.description: ACRA-sourced, e.g. 'Live Company'. Read-only for the founder.

beneficiary_count_est.description: Commonly AI_ESTIMATED. Expect a gap flag on this field.

raise_member.description: VFG: must be true, blocking, REMEDIABLE (apply for membership).

amp_relationship.description: Startup SG Founder: LOR_ISSUED required, blocking, REMEDIABLE.

other_govt_funding.description: Startup SG Founder: must be false for this business concept, blocking, NOT remediable.

readiness.description: Documents VFG requires to START an application (CONTEXT.md §5). Drives the 'what you still need' panel, not eligibility status.

field_meta.description: THE SEAM. Keyed by dot-path into answers, e.g. 'founder.age', 'impact.beneficiary_count_est'. A renders a gap flag wherever source is AI_ESTIMATED or confirmed_by_founder is false. A field absent from this map is treated as UNKNOWN provenance and MUST be flagged.

source.description: FOUNDER = typed or spoke it. AI_EXTRACTED = pulled from their own words, needs confirm-back. AI_ESTIMATED = we guessed, ALWAYS gap-flagged. ACRA = official registry. DEFAULT = schema default, never shown as fact.

confirmed_by_founder.description: Set true only after the confirm-back loop (CONTEXT.md §4).

note.description: Shown verbatim in the gap-flag tooltip. Keep under 120 chars.

stage_progress.description: P2-vertical. One row per (grant, stage). C owns stages.json which defines the stage ids.

elicit_progress.description: Where the founder is in intake. A owns writing this; B reads it to pick the next fixture.
